nodes.title:
Retell architecture.
- Hosting is US-West only. Support (community t/1949): 'Retell infrastructure is only in US(west) region. We don't have any other PoP.' DNS shows SIP and MCP in AWS us-west-2 and the API on Global Accelerator.
- Browser media moved in Sept 2026 from LiveKit Cloud (retell-ai-4ihahnq7.livekit.cloud) to Retell's own WHIP-style WebRTC gateway (web SDK 3.0).
- The SIP allowlist includes 3 LiveKit Inc. IP blocks. Inferred: some PSTN media runs on LiveKit Cloud.
- Orchestration is Retell's own: queues and workers, per the postmortems; no Pipecat or Vocode traces.
- STT: Deepgram, Soniox, Azure, AssemblyAI, plus an unexplained 'Muse'. TTS: ElevenLabs, Cartesia, MiniMax, Fish, OpenAI, Inworld and 'Platform'.

Retell all-in INR per connected minute for an Indian outbound call (ex GST, FX 95, 60 s call, Platform voice).
- BYO Indian SIP trunk, prompt up to 4k tokens: INR 8.3-13.6.
- Same with a 6k-token prompt: INR 8.7-20.0, depending on whether the 4,000-token rule scales only the LLM line or the whole duration.
- Retell-managed US number dialling India: INR 22-37 (Twilio USD 0.15, Telnyx USD 0.25 per min).
That is 2-4x Indian list prices (3.5-7) and 3-6x VP's INR 2-3 target. Reconstructed gross margin at the USD 0.11 calculator default is about 55-70%.
nodes.n: observed rate card x 3 telephony paths x 3 TTS x 3 LLM x 4 call lengths x 2 prompt sizes (324 rows)
nodes.method: Computed from the public pricing page and docs read on 2026-10-20 (international-call, billing-exceptions), with VP's Indian telephony input INR 0.43/min on 30-s pulses (2026-10-18 model inputs.csv). COGS from g4 list prices read on 2026-10-18.

nodes.title:
Retell does nothing India-specific for compliance.
- 0 mentions of TRAI, DLT, NCPR, DPDP or data residency across 338 docs pages.
- Numbers are US/CA only, and caller-ID trust services are US-only; an Indian CLI needs a BYO SIP trunk.
- Calling windows default to America/Los_Angeles, with no TRAI window or warning.
- The internal DNC flag is off by default, honoured by single calls only with honor_internal_dnc=true, and NOT checked by batch calls.
- PII categories are US-centric (no Aadhaar or PAN).
- Active support runs 9 AM-9 PM PST (21:30-09:30 IST).
An Indian buyer carries all TRAI and DPDP work alone; post-sale service calls need less of it than promotional ones.

Retell's Indic coverage is thin.
- Six Indian locales: en-IN, hi-IN, kn-IN, mr-IN, ta-IN, ur-IN. No Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia or Sarvam.
- Forum threads show Hindi digits mis-transcribed, with staff blaming the default Deepgram ASR (t/2713), and Indian multilingual drift back to English (t/2502, 330 views).
- Telugu and Bengali requests got 'try GPT Realtime' (t/1645); Sarvam requests are unanswered (t/2856, t/2866); Indian users fail to connect to the US-West-only service (t/1949).

Retell's outbound surface and data model.
- Batch calls take a CSV with any column as a dynamic variable, plus time windows and reserved concurrency. They have no per-call pacing, no documented retries and no DNC check. The API can only create a batch.
- A 'Campaigns' object with attempts and DNC settings is referenced in the DNC doc and on the homepage, but has no docs page and no endpoint (inferred: new and dashboard-only).
- Strong diagnostics: 39 disconnection reasons, per-call cost line items, per-component latency, PCAP download, live listen and take-over.
- Hidden price multipliers: prompts over 4,000 tokens (including transcript and KB) scale billed duration; a 10-s minimum on a dynamic opener; burst +USD 0.10/min.

Retell reliability and velocity, 2026-04-20 to 2026-10-20.
- Reliability: 12 status incidents (6 major). 2026-09-05: a custom-LLM race stalled the fleet, with about 6 h between onset and the first status post. 2026-09-16: a deploy double-assigned calls and failed about 22% of calls for 43 min.
- Velocity: 80 retell-sdk releases, 16 deprecation notices (2026-04 to 2026-12), 4 marketing changelog posts (none since 08-24), web SDK 3.0 on 09-08, spec revision 2026-10-19.
- Company: USD 80M ARR with 50 staff (vendor job posts).
nodes.n: 12 incidents in 6 months (50 since 2025-03); 80 npm versions; 16 deprecation notices
nodes.method: Read status.retellai.com/api/v2/incidents.json, npm registry metadata, docs llms.txt and the changelog page on 2026-10-20; durations from incident timestamps and postmortem text

nodes.title:
Retell v2 notes.
- Contact memory is one rewritten brief of at most 2,000 characters per phone number, updated after phone or SMS calls; saving is off by default and web calls don't save. Marketing's 'resume where the last call left off' overstates it, consistent with ledger CMP-01.
- Learning: Conductor turns failed calls into simulation tests and proposes fixes for human approval; AI QA cohorts cost USD 0.10/min; A/B uses fixed weights with no statistics. There is no autonomous optimisation.
REA inspect-web-network-capture on a full Playwright HAR with embedded response bodies.
nodes.tried: REA 6.7.0 inspect-web-network-capture on the 15.5 MB dashboard-login HAR, which embeds bodies including a 6.9 MB PNG.
nodes.broke: Decoder failed with 'Capture decoder failed unexpectedly (RangeError)'. The same HAR with bodies and cookies stripped (120 KB) decoded cleanly. Workaround: slim every HAR before giving it to REA. REA analyze-web-bundle over a local CDP Chromium worked on the pricing page (40 scripts, 0 parse failures).

nodes.closes_when: Predictions RET-P01 to RET-P12 in predictions.json are scored against a run on our own Retell trial workspace (Instinct reported it ready, USD 10 credit, TOTP on every login), with stereo handset recordings and a time-and-motion log.

events.details:
Retell lane finished the account-free phase: 60 graded claims (49 observed, 8 inferred, 3 vendor-claimed) and 12 pre-registered predictions.
- Read: 356-page docs index and 338-page corpus; OpenAPI (109 ops, revision 2026-10-19); pricing, changelog and status API; job board; DNS/RDAP; the web SDK source (npm pack, not installed); a slimmed dashboard-login HAR; REA web-bundle of the pricing page; 19 India community threads.
- Hosting: US-West only (staff quote plus DNS). Own orchestration; browser media moved from LiveKit Cloud to Retell's own WHIP gateway in Sept 2026; 3 LiveKit IP blocks in the SIP allowlist.
- Price: India INR 8.3-13.6/min on a BYO trunk, 22-37 via Retell US numbers; prompts over 4k tokens scale billed duration; about 55-70% gross margin at the calculator default.
- India: 0 TRAI/DLT/NCPR/DPDP mentions; US/CA numbers only; LA-default windows; batch calls skip DNC; 6 Indian locales, no Sarvam.
- Velocity: 12 incidents (6 major) and 80 SDK releases in 6 months. USD 80M ARR (vendor).
- Tooling: REA failed on the full HAR (RangeError) and worked once it was slimmed. The harness refused report.md.
